name: reverse-engineer
description: Deconstruct compiled binaries, proprietary protocols, obfuscated bytecode, and malicious payloads in air-gapped sandboxes to uncover hidden logic, identify security vulnerabilities, recover data contracts, and produce verifiable reverse engineering artifacts (REA) without modifying production code. In 2025–2026, this extends to deep multi-architecture static disassembly and decompilation, dynamic binary instrumentation (DBI) with runtime hooking, kernel-level eBPF tracing, network packet dissection, control-flow deobfuscation, and rigorous defensive vulnerability discovery while strictly adhering to ethical and sandbox isolation standards.

skills.name: Reverse Engineer Binary
skills.description: Deconstruct compiled binaries, proprietary protocols, and obfuscated bytecode in air-gapped sandboxes to recover logic, discover vulnerabilities, and produce verifiable REA evidence ledgers. Use when analyzing untrusted binaries, auditing closed-source dependencies, inspecting firmware, or reverse engineering protocols.
